text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking with Mejiro Dober…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober! Perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: We were just on our way to see you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fine and Hishiama? What did you need me for?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Remember that hot pot roulette tea party we had before? We were hoping to hold another one. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Th-that again? …Really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, a while back, Fine invited us to a tea party, and…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: All right, everyone! Let's make a mystery hot pot that'll go well with tea!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Don't tea parties usually involve chiffon cake and cookies? What kind of hot pot would go with tea?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that sounds fun! It'll be like we're brewing a potion! Let's put a bunch of stuff in!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Let's not go overboard!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: This is my first mystery hot pot. We never did these at the Mejiro estate…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This is a first for me too! I'm sure it will make for a great reminiscent clover!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I wonder who brought the most interesting ingredient? All right, let's get this hot pot roulette started! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Th-this looks kind of toxic…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What's this? Rainbow candy?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh! That's my Special ☆ Magic Candy! It has seven mysterious flavors and—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yuck! Or it's supposed to, anyway! What are these bitter seeds?! It's not sweet at all now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That must be my contribution. Ardan gave me some medicinal ingredients to use.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Plus I got protein powder from Ryan, so I put that in too…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wow! Those sound like really healthy ingredients! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I-I feel like my macarons are the most normal thing in there now…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: By the way… What did you put in, Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Me? Black pudding. ♪

text_block_list.name: Everyone but Fine
text_block_list.text: Ewwwww!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: After that, everyone made a fuss about the smell, and Hishiama got really mad at us…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Going into the kitchen gave me the scare of my life! Some weird smoke was pourin' out of it, and everyone had collapsed!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm gonna be there this time, so nothing like that'll happen again!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We'll make it a fun and delicious hot pot roulette party this time! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I don't know… I'm sure it'll be fine with Hishiama there, but…
choice_data_list: Go on and make some fun memories.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …What are you so excited for?
choice_data_list: You have what it takes to win, whether it's a race or hot pot roulette.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm not going to hold back if I'm doing this, but I don't know how well I'll do…
choice_data_list: You have what it takes to win, whether it's a race or hot pot roulette.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Don't be ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pfft. Don't be silly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to head to the shopping district and see what tasty and interesting things I can get, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to head to the shopping district and see what tasty and interesting things I can get, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …See you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The second hot pot roulette party concludes without any strange smells, but it apparently still tasted diabolical.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Mejiro Dober seems quite satisfied, since she was crowned Hot Pot Derby champion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I was planning on doing solo training today…
choice_data_list: You have to enjoy yourself outside of racing too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh. Who are you? My keeper?
choice_data_list: Being with friends is one of the best parts of school life.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …You really think so?
choice_data_list: Being with friends is one of the best parts of school life.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …All right, fine. I'll go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Okay… I suppose I'll go spend some time with everyone, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The second hot pot roulette party concludes without any strange smells, but it apparently still tasted diabolical.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The second hot pot roulette party concludes without any strange smells, but it apparently still tasted diabolical.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even so, Mejiro Dober looks quite happy as she recounts the details of the party to me.
